deployments_detail.use: Aurora Driver autonomous Class 8 trucks (Kenworth/Peterbilt), commercial driverless launch targeted; PACCAR Connect telematics

Level 4 autonomous long-haul trucks: PACCAR co-develops and manufactures autonomy-enabled Peterbilt 579 and Kenworth T680 trucks integrated with the Aurora Driver; Aurora launched commercial driverless service in Texas in April 2025 using these PACCAR trucks. [Aurora Innovation]

Aurora driverless network scale-up running PACCAR (Peterbilt/Kenworth) and other platform trucks; company reports 250,000+ driverless miles and 10 routes as of early 2026, confirming ongoing commercial operation of the autonomous system PACCAR builds trucks for. [Aurora Innovation]

Neural-network-based perception for highly automated driving: PACCAR fits trucks with exterior cameras/sensors and runs imagery through neural networks on the NVIDIA DRIVE platform (using transfer learning from NVIDIA's car-trained models) to build environmental awareness for driver safety. [NVIDIA (DRIVE platform)]

Proof-of-concept Level 4 self-driving truck built with NVIDIA on the DRIVE PX 2 AI computing platform, using deep learning to perceive surroundings, localize on a map, and plot a safe path. [NVIDIA (DRIVE PX 2)]

Machine learning on connected-truck data to predict vehicle health at individual and fleet level, enhancing uptime and optimizing cost of quality (feeding PACCAR's Smart Campaigns); multi-year agreement integrating Viaduct's platform with PACCAR telematics, diagnostics, and repair data pipelines. [Viaduct]

SmartLINQ remote diagnostics: factory-installed connected-truck telematics that continuously monitors 900+ engine and emissions codes, analyzes them via a reasoning engine, and pushes real-time fleet-health alerts and severity assessments to fleet managers and support teams. [Peterbilt / PACCAR (Decisiv service platform)]

Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (Bendix Fusion) on Kenworth T680 and Peterbilt 579: forward-facing camera + radar sensor fusion powering collision mitigation, automatic emergency braking, adaptive cruise (Stop & Auto-Go), and lane-departure/alert prioritization, deployed as factory options. [Bendix Commercial Vehicle Systems]

Kenworth Digital Driver Display (15-inch): fully digital instrumentation surfacing real-time diagnostics, safety alerts and ADAS/adaptive cruise state, with SmartLINQ integration; the in-cab HMI for the driver-assistance and connected-diagnostics stack, standard/available across models. [Kenworth / PACCAR]

PACCAR Parts Managed Dealer Inventory (MDI) and PACCAR Transportation System: data-analytics/computer-modeling that generates daily parts-order recommendations per dealer to optimize availability and inventory turns, and determines most-efficient inbound delivery routes to distribution centers. [PACCAR Parts (in-house)]

AI-Driven Identity Security in production to consolidate and clean up access roles, automate role management, and improve governance/compliance visibility across 8 HR systems and 32,000+ employees. [SailPoint (Identity Security Cloud)]
